status: FIRST external numerical ground.speed outcome freeze; source-only 294,683 GPS row/36 individual both-branch coarse-cell support already opened. Movement speed VALUES NOT OPENED, so all speed endpoints/signs frozen before first value inspection.

source.timestamp: Original UTC per publisher, not assumed local
source.location: Original GPS WGS84 used ephemerally to derive solar geometry and 0.5° cells only; never publish raw locations or exact individual IDs.

biological_question: At the same approximate site-local astronomical daylength on opposite seasonal branches, does the same marked bird's daytime-versus-nighttime GPS ground speed allocation change? Does any direction replicate across individually sampled bird taxa independent of camera detector systems?

unit.pre_source_cell: SAME study.name×individual.id, SAME 0.5° lat/long grid and December21 solstice-year. A bird can contribute multiple cells or cycles, but final taxon aggregate weights each independent individual equally across such groups.
unit.hemisphere: Must satisfy abs(latitude)>=1°, northern solstice branches before Dec21 falling and after rising, southern reversed; source preflight k=7..160 days is immutable.
unit.solar_hour: At each original GPS UTC timestamp and source GPS coordinate, use NOAA sun declination, equation of time and solar zenith; DAY where computed apparent solar elevation >= -0.833° (the same upper-limb/refraction convention), NIGHT otherwise. Never classify by a fixed clock-hour offset.
unit.daily_support: Within each individual×cell×solstice UTC-calendar date and photoperiod branch, require >=3 finite plausible GPS ground-speed readings in solar daylight and >=3 in night. This is SPEED SAMPLE OPPORTUNITY check, not time-corrected animal observation.
unit.daylength: At that indiv×cell×solstice year, calculate modeled astronomical daylight minutes for every candidate UTC date from the SOURCE latitudes' per-cell median, not event speed. Match eligible one rising and one falling date within <=5 minutes daylight length using deterministic minimum-absolute-daylength-difference greedy one-to-one matching (ties by dates). No date reused; choose based only on astronomy and source observation availability.
unit.sensor_speed: Original GPS ground.speed in meters/second, include only finite 0<=speed<=60 m/s, retain clipped/excluded records count. Ground speed is sensor-estimated, NOT animal energy use or proof of locomotor activity.
unit.source_duty: For each candidate paired date and each solar day/night zone, require >=3 original valid ground-speed samples per date AND ratio of falling/rising fix counts in [0.5,2]. If outside reject pair before any result reading. Report number of duty-balanced pairs.
unit.eligibility: Individual×cell×solstice group qualifies for reported GPS speed contrast if >=5 DISTINCT matched date pairs satisfy astronomical and source duty criteria; otherwise record support-only, no estimated effect. For population-level descriptive species comparison require >=5 distinct individuals, and for cross-species claim require >=2 such species.

endpoints.per_date: median log(1+ground.speed_m_s) of source GPS readings for each DAY and NIGHT solar class (not mean raw distance/number of GPS points).
endpoints.per_pair_delta: [night−day speed log-median]_falling − [night−day speed log-median]_rising, at equal daylength and same individual×region.
endpoints.per_individual_cellcycle: mean across all source matched date-pair deltas in the group; each date used once
endpoints.per_individual: mean of all eligible same individual×cell×solstice group means; one animal only contributes once within a species
endpoints.per_species: mean and median of eligible independent-individual effects; count positive/negative/tied animal-level effect signs; leave-one-individual-out min/max of species mean (NOT confidence interval); keep all seven taxa and undefined low support.
endpoints.sampling_observational_quality: Report actual original timestamps row counts, speed availability, speed >60 rejected, spatial/same-individual matched pairs, day/night fix counts per branch. NO event-level independent animal p-values.
endpoints.prior_source_replay: Exact original Duck source-only 294,683 row count and MD5, original 7 taxa, 36 preliminary individual branch support MUST replay; do not alter previous GPS source status/effort hist.

sensitivity_and_limit: Fix timing varies by animal battery, species tag model (1h or 2h), cloud/weather and GSM success; even speed sensor values can vary by GPS conditions. Matching day/night sample count does not fully identify continuous-time behavioral budgets.
Comparisons remain within 0.5° (~tens of km), not same individual exact microhabitat; site relocation and resource changes can contribute.
Source captures in migration/wintering season vary among taxa and years; a nonzero within-individual speed response could reflect context/migration stage as well as seasonal memory.
Species under n=5 independent animals are displayed as insufficient for species-level inference; no post-hoc taxa or date-window rescue.
GPS movement is a different response from Serengeti camera PHOTO detection; do not pool raw effect sizes as one estimand or claim field replication of particular zebra/hyena OR.
Only one independent GPS publication across several countries, not a randomized set of independent landscapes; count independent individuals/cells/studies and distinguish.
No causal NDVI/temperature, photoperiod entrainment, animal behavioral activity, conservation impact or universal hysteresis claim from observational GPS sensor speeds.
